scope: Literary analysis of Ariosto’s 1532 poem: ottava rima, interlace, desire, women, religious identities, dynastic patronage, fame and translation.
editorial_boundary: Interprets the 1532 text and its scholarly reception; earlier editions, Boiardo and later English reception are not conflated. Literary judgments are not attributed as documented authorial intent.
